_source: Investing for the very long term — preparatory dossier, July 2026. Part VI.

rules.text: I contribute the planned amount every quarter, on a fixed date, whatever the market does.
I look at my portfolio only twice a year: end of June and end of December.
rules.enforced: positions view locked outside those months; overrides logged

rules.text: I never sell a core holding before I am 25, except in case of vital necessity.
rules.enforced: core is out of scope for this tool

rules.text: If the market falls by more than 20%, I do nothing — and I keep contributing. A fall is not a loss; it is a lower purchase price.
The learning sleeve never exceeds 10%. If I lose money there, I do not top it up.
rules.enforced: four slots, hard; accept disabled above cap; top-up refused when underwater

rules.text: I use no leverage, in any form, ever.
rules.enforced: leveraged and inverse instruments excluded from the universe

rules.text: I buy nothing I cannot explain in three sentences to a friend.
rules.enforced: three-sentence summary generated and shown before accepting

rules.text: I rebalance once a year, in January, by directing new contributions towards the sleeve that has fallen behind, rather than by selling.
Before every purchase in the learning sleeve, I write down why I am buying and what would make me sell. Without that text, no purchase.
rules.enforced: case and quantified triggers auto-drafted and stored on accept; confidence required

rules.text: Any change to this charter is written down, dated, and takes effect only thirty days later. No important decision is taken on the day I feel like taking it.
rules.enforced: pending_changes below; effective_from must pass before it applies

accepted_in_advance: Over forty years, my portfolio will lose more than 30% on three or four occasions, and perhaps more than 50% once. I know this today, in the cold. On the day it happens, I will re-read this sentence before doing anything at all.

compliance.note: The personal account dealing rules of a financial institution generally cover the accounts of related persons, including minor children. Pre-clearance may be required, particularly for the learning sleeve in individual securities. Confirm with compliance before the account is opened.
